logical.byte_bit_rule: v3 b_S=b_R=1 means Byte/element, not 1-bit arithmetic. Encoded copies add physical occupancy, never logical payload.

physical.encoding: eight binary FeFET cells per signed INT8 weight; two-complement sign in digital reduction
physical.physical_organization: 32 lateral row lanes x 64 local strips x (4 layers x 16 BL/SL column pairs)
physical.update_shape: one input index x sixteen aligned outputs; all eight binary planes together
physical.maintenance: no periodic refresh or destructive restore; local service only

neurosim_array_assignment.rule: Never substitute logical K,N for a physical array; preserve native banks, plane orientation, active rows, isolation and access direction.

physical.access_direction: weight[o,i] bit b -> lane=i%32; layer=i//32; strip=(o//16)*8+b; column=o%16

native_mapping.strip_definition: One local WL segment per layer, four stacked layers and sixteen BL/SL column pairs; one output group and one binary weight plane.
native_mapping.physical_address: weight[o,i] bit b -> lane=i%32; layer=i//32; strip=(o//16)*8+b; column=o%16
native_mapping.read_layer_selection: Each row lane selects one layer; other layers held off. Thirty-two lateral row lanes, not four stack layers, supply concurrent operands.

digital_holding.lifetime: One 32-row x 16-output x 8-bit tile through all eight input slices, then replace; partial sums live until output completion. The same bank captures terminal verify while streaming is idle.

device.identity: vertical AND FeFET; lateral strips and four capacity layers
device.native_technology_policy: Retain native device bias/load/geometry independently of the low-voltage peripheral technology; no 28nm Technology table or enum relabeling.

native_electrical_parameter_policy.fallback: retain native complete service or stated primitive; never silently use upstream default device/load

vertical_AND_FeFET.local_bias_scheme: For polarity s: selected WL=2sVw/3; other layer WL=sVw/3; target BL=SL=-sVw/3; inhibited BL=SL=+sVw/3. Positive phase targets ones, negative phase targets zeroes.
vertical_AND_FeFET.read_bias_status: complete40ns engineering read retained; source-0.5V stress pulse is not silently transplanted as operating bias

clock.rule: actual=max(target_period_ns, measured used sensing/combinational critical path); DFF alone does not prove closure

periphery.scope: Low-voltage peripheral candidates only; native array/driver/sense complete services retain their original load and bias.

resources.capacity_policy: Installed capacity is not active parallelism. No extra ADC, SA, hold bank, driver or mux lane may appear without a resource edit.

mux_scope.rule: Ratios express selected outputs/local addresses; native row/layer/CIMSEL decoding is separate. No switch capacitance or RC assumed from fanin alone.
